subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output completion semantics, or should it be split/closed behind the open reply-runtime and fallback canonicals?
rationale: Current main only partially fixes the UI affordance, while the remaining behavior spans protocol/runtime/session state and fallback policy that require maintainer contract direction.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Leave this issue open as the visible cross-surface tracker until structured reply metadata and final fallback behavior are both landed or explicitly redirected.

options.title: Split Behind Canonicals
options.body: Move the reply metadata work to the reply-runtime issue/PR and the no-output work to the fallback issue, then close this issue with links once maintainers confirm the split.

options.title: Scope To Control UI Only
options.body: Keep this issue focused only on Control UI reply metadata and defer no-output semantics entirely to the fallback contract issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the visible cross-surface tracker until structured reply metadata and final fallback behavior are both landed or explicitly redirected.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping final fallback contract issue, which is the unresolved product-policy half of this umbrella and the part most likely to block closure.
